newsitem.title: USA: Rally's to post costs from attempted merger.
newsitem.headline: Rally's to post costs from attempted merger.

text.p: Rally's Hamburgers Inc on Wednesday said it will in its second quarter results post costs related to terminated merger negotiations with Checker's Drive-In Restaurants Inc.

Rally's said the merger was inhibited because it would have been accounted for as a "purchase" -- and not a "pooling" as anticipated in the letter of intent -- limiting the value that the post-merger shareholders of the combined entity could reasonably expect to realize.
The company said that despite the costs, it expects that its controllable cost economics should continue the strong performance of the past three quarters.
